To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
some cell bodies in the dorsal horn contain CGRP-like immunofluorescence.
CGRP immunoreactive neurons are located in the dorsal horn as well as in the lateral spinal nucleus.
some cells of the superficial dorsal horn of the spinal cord contain a calcitonin gene related peptide like immunoreactivity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the distribution of CGRP-like immunostained cell bodies in the dorsal horn (DH) and lateral spinal nucleus in the rat cervical spinal Cord (C1–C3).
the presence in the dorsal horn (DH) of the spinal cord of neurons which contain calcitonin gene related peptide (CGRP).
the presence of CGRP-like neurons in the spinal cord, which is in agreement with previous studies in other species.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CGRP is present in a few cell bodies in the superficial laminae of the dorsal horn of control animals and in a few additional cell bodies after intraventricular administration of colchicine.
the CGRP-immunoreactive cell bodies observed in the rat cervical spinal dorsal horn and LSn are not of primary afference origin, but represent a population of intrinsic spinal neurons.
CGRP-like immunostaining is not confined to primary afferents, but that it can also be observed in cell bodies and dendrites of dorsal horn and LSn neurons.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CGRP-like immunostaining in the dorsal horn is not only a marker of primary afferents but is also present in some dorsal horn and LSn neurons.
CGRP-like immunopositive neurons are present in the dorsal horn, and the LSn, of the rat spinal cervical cord.
some neurons in the rat spinal cord contain a substance which cross-reacts with CGRP antisera.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CGRP is not only expressed in the primary afferent fibers but also in the dorsal horn neurons.
there are CGRP-like neurons in the rat dorsal horn and LSn, and that these neurons are probably the source of the CGRP-like immunostaining observed in the neuropil of the dorsal horn.
there are CGRP-like cellbodies in the dorsal horn that may be intrinsic to the dorsal horn.
